newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian blue chips may rise more on basket buying.
newsitem.headline: Belgian blue chips may rise more on basket buying.

text.p: Belgian blue-chip shares could rise further next week after soaring on Friday afternoon amid waves of Bel-20 basket buying which continued after the traditionally volatile settlement of index futures and options.

"This agressive buying could continue -- in the past it has sometimes gone on for a few days. If not, investors who have wanted to take profits can do," one dealer said. He could find no obvious reason for the basket buying.
The Bel-20 index .BFX closed 24.37 points or 1.13 percent higher at 2,171.71, with a hefty 6.7 billion francs worth of Belgian shares traded.
Initially market sentiment was dampened by a weaker dollar and losses on Wall Street overnight, though the Dow Jones .DJI gave some reassurance on Friday by opening firmer.

Bucking the uptrend was oil major Petrofina, which has been driven higher in recent sessions mainly by warrant-related buying. It fell 0.39 percent to 12,675 francs, and one dealer noted there was now a single big seller in the stock.
Between May 20 and June 3 Petrofina warrants can be exercised at a rate of one per share with the price for the shares set at 12,500 Belgian francs.
